allowed.reason: Reached only through minio -> query-string@7. minio 8.0.7 is the latest release and is CommonJS; every patched version in that chain (decode-uri-component 0.5.1, query-string 9.5.x and 10) is ESM-only, so an override makes require() return an object instead of a function and MinIO throws at runtime.
